main_text.p: de, quod angelus Gabriel apud Danielem tempus visionis obsignandæ[?] & adventus Christi incluserit intra septuaginta hebdomadas: dixeratque post hebdomadas septem & sexaginta duas (id est lxix) excindendum fuisse Messiam ducem: Dan. 9: 24. 25. quæ res proin ita tem-pori alligata fuit, ut sine subversione veritatis propheticæ anticipari non potuerit, æque minus ac in posteriora differri.
main_text.head: APODICTICA RESPONSI
APPLICATIO.
main_text.p: ESt in hâc pericopâ responsum divinum, singulari modo propagatum, dum in tabulis exaratum fuit, & juxta præceptum Dei in locis publicis affixum, quo omnes etiam curfum lo-gant. Hoc responsum Dei relatum est ad dilceptatio-nem Prophetæ, nomine justorum in populo factam: in quo dubia solvuntur, & hæsitationes ex follicito-rum animis satis solidè eximuntur.

1. Prima hæsitatio fuit, si Chaldæus ita immittatur in Judæos, fore ut populus Dei segregatus à gentibus pereat, emoriatur, & non amplius superfit in orbe: atque ita actum erit cum visione legis & prophetarum:

page.notes: The word after "visionis" at the line end is printed "ol-" with a hyphen, and the next line begins "obsignandæ"; the first letter is ambiguous in the scan (b or l), so it is marked [?]. "lxix" in the parenthesis is printed with spacing that could also read as "lx ix"; transcribed as printed-looking "lxix". A small stray mark stands above "pereat" in the text; not transcribed. The woodcut initial "E" is joined to "St" as "ESt". The running head is taken from the small-caps line at the top, without the page number.
